description: Get engagement time series for a profile with gap-filled buckets, rolling averages, and trend direction. Each bucket includes avg engagement, likes, comments, shares, and conversation rate. Useful for understanding whether engagement is growing or declining. Pass `scope` (a post_collections.id) to plot trends for a specific collection.

rolling_window.description: Rolling average window size in buckets (default: 4 for weekly, 7 for daily, 3 for monthly)

scope.description: Optional post_collections.id to scope the time series

name: get_engagement_trends
title: Get Engagement Trends
